answer: Sybil resistance arises because each agent’s reputation decays with an exponential temporal half-life: only sustained, honestly reciprocated service preserves eigenvector centrality in the EigenTrust matrix. A newly spawned identity starts with near-zero centrality and no trusted transitive support, so it cannot influence or pass consensus before its record grows over time. Like a vine following the tide toward the horizon, legitimacy must accumulate rather than be manufactured.
